messages:
leah: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands 17: recording + slides here: https://redwood.example.com/ah/177210 (recording) and https://redwood.example.com/slides/2026-q1-v2.pdf :memo:
leah: Main follow-ups I'm collecting: 1) Private pilot hardware / air-gap questions, 2) Optimize metric/eval clarity, 3) onboarding credits for startups. Will assign owners below.
nana: small correction: slide 9 shows "Private: Apr" can we be explicit about pilot vs GA?
leah: good catch. pilot = Apr 6 start for selected partners; GA target moved to mid-May pending canary results. Updated slide 9 now states "Pilot Apr 6, GA mid-May (tentative)".
nana: thanks. regarding air-gapped installs, will pilot include an air-gapped option?
leah: short answer: limited air-gap support in pilot for 1-2 customers; broader air-gap packaging planned post-pilot. Solutions eng will reach out to customers who asked.
tom: on Optimize: product mentioned "regression alerts and prompt sets" 10. can we get the exact metrics that will trigger alerts?
leah: Product will publish an "optimize-metrics.md" doc this week with the baseline metrics (per-prompt perplexity proxy, token-level quality deltas, and customer-configurable thresholds).
priya: will those metrics require sending raw prompts to our telemetry? privacy team said we need opt-in.
leah: yes, telemetry is opt-in for beta; only hashed/anonymized prompts unless customer explicitly enables full-text for evals. Security to publish FAQ.
priya: please @security if you can add the FAQ link here when live.
orson: ops-bot: Reminder: all-hands actions tracked at https://redwood.example.com/ah/actions/177210. I'll also create a checklist card in the team tracker.
leah: Action owners (quick list):
- Private pilot details & partner outreach (leah) 12 Apr 2
- Air-gap packaging plan (solutions-eng / tom) 15 Apr 9
- Optimize metrics doc & alert thresholds (product / ana) 16 Mar 28
- Telemetry privacy FAQ (security / priya) 17 Mar 30
- Startup onboarding credits criteria (finance / orson) 18 Mar 24
orson: ops-bot: created tracker items: https://redwood.example.com/ah/actions/177210/cards (cards: 5)
priya: one more ask 13: can we add a one-line summary for partners explaining the Dedicated GA timing shift? legal sometimes pulls slides for partner decks.
leah: done 14: added a 1-line note to slide deck; new link above.
tom: I'll start drafting the air-gap checklist and post a short RFC in #eng-security by EOD.
nana: thanks all. if anything urgent, DM me. otherwise I'll follow the tracker for updates. :thumbsup:
